title: mix e2e drives one issue through the real factory on the sandbox repo, nightly

story.i_want_to: run one command that opens an issue on mkreyman/loopctl-e2e-sandbox and watches the deployed factory take it to done, failing with the stage it stuck at
story.so_that: a release is proven on the whole path, not on each part alone, and a regression shows the next morning

rationale: PRD R7 defines the happy path (issue, intake, triage, placement, PR passing chg and CI, review, merge, issue closed, item done, nothing open in any queue) and requires it nightly and on every factory release. The existing test/e2e suite (tagged :e2e, test_helper.exs:92-97, run by ci.yml:486-487 and mix test.e2e, mix.exs:273) runs in-process against the test database: it cannot drive a runner, chg, GitHub or a deploy, so it cannot serve. The new suite is a black box against loopctl.com and the fleet. No API maps an issue to its story today: the story list (StoryController.index_by_project, story_controller.ex:346, filters :354-356) has no issue filter, although Story has intake_record_id (story.ex:121) and the intake Record has issue_number (record.ex:63).

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /api/v1/projects/:project_id/stories?issue_number=N returns the stories whose intake record (stories.intake_record_id) has issue_number N, scoped to the caller's tenant and that project; the MCP tool list_stories accepts issue_number and sends it, with a wiring test and an mcp-server/README.md row.

e2e/ is its own mix project (app :loopctl_e2e, deps req and jason only), and the root alias e2e is ["cmd --cd e2e mix test"], so mix e2e from the repository root runs it; the root suite and the existing mix test.e2e alias are unchanged.

One happy-path run opens an issue on mkreyman/loopctl-e2e-sandbox titled 'e2e <run_id>: add Sandbox.Runs.R<run_id>.value/0 returning <run_id>' with the label the sandbox intake source watches, where run_id is the UTC timestamp plus 6 random hex characters.

The run polls, with backoff from 10 s to 120 s, for each stage in order: story created for the issue (AC-52.9.1), triaged, dispatched, PR opened, chg and CI green, review recorded, merged, deployment recorded, issue closed with a loopctl:resolution-* label, story done; a stage not reached within its budget (total 120 minutes) fails the run naming that stage, the story id and the last state read.

After done, the run asserts nothing is left open for that story: story_stage shows no in-flight dispatch, escalation_list has no row for it, the sandbox has no open PR whose head branch names it, and the issue is closed; any leftover fails the run naming it.

e2e/sandbox/provision.sh, run with a GitHub token, makes the sandbox repo match e2e/sandbox/template/ (a mix app gated by chg, a CI workflow on [self-hosted, fleet-ci], a master workflow recording a GitHub deployment in environment production, the intake label) and is idempotent: a second run changes nothing and says so.

.github/workflows/e2e.yml runs mix e2e nightly at 07:00 UTC and on workflow_dispatch on [self-hosted, fleet-ci] in concurrency group e2e (never cancelled), reading LOOPCTL_E2E_ORCH_KEY and E2E_GITHUB_TOKEN from repository secrets; a failure uploads the run's stage log as an artifact.

The e2e area job (US-52.6's changed-areas.sh area e2e) runs mix compile --warnings-as-errors, format --check-formatted, credo --strict and mix test --exclude live in e2e/, where the harness's stage machine and backoff are unit-tested against a stubbed client.

test_cases.name: issue_number filter and tenant isolation (ConnCase)
preconditions: tenant A project P with two stories, one linked to an intake record with issue_number 42; tenant B with a story linked to issue 42 on its own project
expected_results: exactly A's linked story; 404 or empty for B (never A's story)

test_cases.name: mix e2e reaches the e2e project
steps: read Mix.Project.config()[:aliases][:e2e] in a root test
assert e2e/mix.exs has app :loopctl_e2e and deps exactly req and jason
expected_results: the alias and the deps match

test_cases.name: stage machine walks every stage and fails on a stall (e2e unit, stubbed client)
preconditions: a stub client scripted to reach each stage in turn, and one that stops at 'merged'
steps: run the harness with a fake clock on each stub
expected_results: first: :ok after ten stages and the issue title matches the run_id form; second: {:error, {:stuck, "merged", story_id, last_state}} once the stage budget passes; backoff intervals never exceed 120 s

test_cases.name: leftover detection (e2e unit, stubbed client)
preconditions: stubs: one clean; one with an escalation row; one with an open PR
steps: run the final assertion on each
expected_results: ok; fails naming the escalation; fails naming the PR

test_cases.name: the live happy path (tagged :live)
preconditions: the sandbox provisioned, its intake source enrolled, two runners declaring the sandbox repo, LOOPCTL_E2E_ORCH_KEY and E2E_GITHUB_TOKEN set
expected_results: exit 0 inside 120 minutes; the run's file exists on the sandbox master

test_cases.name: provision idempotence and workflow shape
preconditions: a gh stub recording calls and answering from a fixture repo state
steps: run provision.sh twice against the stub
parse .github/workflows/e2e.yml and the e2e job in US-52.6's workflow
expected_results: the second run makes no write call and prints 'sandbox up to date'; cron '0 7 * * *', workflow_dispatch, fleet-ci, group e2e with cancel-in-progress false; the area job runs the four checks in e2e/

technical_notes: Filter: extend StoryController.index_by_project (lib/loopctl_web/controllers/story_controller.ex:346, the filter map :354-356) and its context query with a join to intake_records on stories.intake_record_id (lib/loopctl/work_breakdown/story.ex:121; Loopctl.Intake.Record issue_number at lib/loopctl/intake/record.ex:63). Add issue_number to the operation's parameters (OpenApiSpex) and to list_stories in mcp-server/index.js. An existing route and tool are extended; no new one.

Reading progress uses existing reads only: GET story (status), story_stage (the stage row and in-flight dispatch), escalation_list, and the GitHub API for the PR, checks, deployments and the issue's labels. Stage names follow docs/agent-delivery-loop.md (placement by DispatchDriver; verify@1 on a runner other than the implementer's; IntakeIssueCloseWorker closes the issue with a loopctl:resolution-* label; completion moves verified to done).
The sandbox's deploy is a GitHub deployment record only (environment production, the default DELIVERY_DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENT read by PostDeployVerification); nothing is hosted.

One-time setup by the implementing session, through MCP, recorded in e2e/config/sandbox.exs (ids only, no secrets): a project for the sandbox in Mark's tenant; intake_source_enroll for mkreyman/loopctl-e2e-sandbox with its target epic; set_github_credential (or a VERIFICATION_OPERATOR_TOKEN_TENANTS pair); a DELIVERY_GATES_CONFIG entry for the sandbox; and two fleet runners whose runner.json repos list the sandbox (verify@1 needs a second runner). The orchestrator key and the GitHub token go into repository secrets with gh secret set, from where earlier sessions keep them.
Each run adds one file lib/sandbox/runs/r<run_id>.ex to the sandbox; nothing prunes them (defaults).

Harness modules: LoopctlE2e.Client (behaviour; Req implementation; a stub in tests), LoopctlE2e.Stages (the ordered stage list, each a read and a predicate), LoopctlE2e.Run (the loop with an injected clock). The live test is tagged :live and excluded unless LOOPCTL_E2E_ORCH_KEY is set.
e2e/ joins US-52.6's changed-areas.sh area e2e (already listed there); the root .formatter.exs and .credo.exs stay rooted at lib/test/config, so e2e/ carries its own.
non_goals: Running the suite at the end of a rollout: US-52.10.
Unhappy paths (a rejected review, a red CI, an escalation): later releases.
Replacing test/e2e: it stays the in-process journey suite.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.9.4: a lost connection to loopctl or GitHub is one failed poll; the next poll retries under the same stage budget, and the run fails only when the budget passes, naming the stage.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.9.3: the run's identity is its run_id in the issue title and the sandbox file; the harness keeps no state outside the run, and the factory's state is read, never written.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.9.7: the e2e concurrency group runs one at a time; a re-run uses a new run_id, so two runs never share an issue.
failure_modes.slow: AC-52.9.4: each stage has a budget inside 120 minutes and polling backs off to 120 s, so a slow stage fails with its name, never hangs the job.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.9.7: the run executes on the fleet-ci pool and reaches loopctl.com and GitHub over HTTPS only.

defaults: Nightly at 07:00 UTC, after ci.yml's 02:00 run (owner may move it).
The sandbox keeps every run's file; nothing prunes them.
A total budget of 120 minutes per run.
definition_of_done: gh run list -R mkreyman/loopctl -w e2e.yml shows a successful workflow_dispatch run on the epic branch.
The sandbox issue of that run is closed with a loopctl:resolution-* label, and story_stage for its story reads done.
